verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents its own test-case scripting: AI features write test cases, and the `hopp test` CLI runs API tests and emits JUnit reports. That confirms a test-script capability exists, but no evidence shows assertions specifically against response status, body, or headers. missing for 10: documented assertion syntax for response status, body, and headers; a dedicated test-scripting reference; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write test assertions against response status, body, and headers
